result.one_liner: SEO and backlink analysis platform providing API access to search, domain, and competitor data for paid subscribers.

evidence.quote: API Key (Bearer token) for direct Enterprise API v3 access, and OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow for Ahrefs Connect
Starter and the free tier get no API access at all. API access requires Lite or higher; Starter and Ahrefs Free are excluded.
Ahrefs API v3 lets you pull organic and backlinks data from Site Explorer, keyword metrics and ideas from Keywords Explorer, Google SERP data
monthly unit budgets are tier-gated and shared with the MCP server and Ahrefs Connect on the same plan

result.notes: API requires paid Lite plan ($129/mo) or higher for access. Bearer token and OAuth 2.0 are primary auth methods. Official MCP server available. API v2 deprecated as of Nov 2025; v3 is current.
